shortDescription: Set network SYSLOG Client parameters in WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: address
options.description: Sets the IP Address of the SYSLOG server to contact.

options.name: clear
options.description: Removes all the IP block entries for the protocol being defined before setting the newly defined entries.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: index
options.description: Index of the IP block being modified.

options.name: port
options.description: Defines the port number used by the SYSLOG Client (1 - 65535).

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol that the SYSLOG entry should be applied. 0 = ipv4, 1 = ipv6.

options.name: secure
options.description: Defines if a secure connection is used by the SYSLOG Client (TCP Transport required).

options.name: transport
options.description: Defines the transfer protocol type used by the SYSLOG Client. 0=UDP, 1=TCP;

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
